## Benoit Busser

Benoit Busser is Professor of Biochemistry and Cancer Sciences at Université Grenoble Alpes and senior medical biochemist at Grenoble Alpes University Hospital.

His academic and clinical activities sit at the interface of laboratory medicine, translational research, cancer sciences and elemental imaging.
